description: This file defines a Perl module named Error that provides object-oriented error/exception handling functionality, including throw, catch, try, finally, and other syntactic sugar, as well as error class definitions. It includes error classes Error and Error::Simple, and handles error propagation, stack traces, and customizing error messages.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: The base class for error objects, supporting error information, stack traces, object association, and overload methods for stringification and value.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: A subclass of Error representing simple string errors with optional associated values, with methods for string representation.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: A package providing the 'try', 'catch', 'finally', 'except', and 'otherwise' syntax for structured exception handling in Perl.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: A package that overrides Perl's warn and die handlers to produce detailed stack traces and error information.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Error object, capturing caller info, setting up stack traces if debugging enabled.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws the error object, causing it to be caught by a surrounding try block or terminating the program.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a new Error object with given arguments (syntactic sugar).

methods.name: record
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Error object with given arguments (syntactic sugar).

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the string of the stack trace if debugging is enabled, otherwise constructs minimal info.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error object with another object (hash or glob) for error propagation.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Returns the object associated with the error, if any.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Returns the filename where the error was created.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error was created.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Overload method that returns the error message text for string context.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the associated value of the error, if any.
